front: Monday's eight games had three blowouts (New Orleans by 21 over Golden State, Miami by 18 over Houston, Memphis by 16 over Washington), and late news took Houston out of both halves (Amen Thompson sat after being Questionable at your PM lock) and Philadelphia out of the morning (LeBron). Jaylen Brown (57.6), Davion Mitchell (46.6) and Julius Randle (49.7) were the big nights against ETR; Bam Adebayo left after 16 minutes with 4 points. Your 100 teams had a median finish in the top 40%; 12 made the top 10% and none the top 1%, and 31 cashed, $326 back on $460, the best return in a week. The two biggest bets carried it: Donovan Mitchell on 43% of your teams (field 17%; holders 2.5 times the field at the top 10%) and Embiid on 38% (2.0 times). The board's biggest order moves were the weak part again: in the afternoon your board went with ETR's side on only 27% of the close calls it split on (season 45%, where ETR alone wins), and of the 16 biggest calls against ADP and ETR, 3 were right (the Gobert and Bane raises, the Lillard fade). Since Friday those biggest calls are 7 right and 31 wrong, so where your order breaks from ETR's in the afternoon, the evidence keeps saying to trust ETR. Today: Tuesday main, lock 4:22pm PT.
